title: Avery's first morning
intro: It's 1 September. Avery Santos signs in to the Mosaic team's workspace for the first time. Their account is new, and the workspace requires coach setup. Avery clicks Engagements in the menu and lands back on the setup page.

o: The Engagements page is broken. Report a bug.
Avery is held on coach setup. The amber notice names the page they tried to open, and they'll go straight to it once setup is done.

f.0: Nothing's broken. The menu brings held coaches back to setup on purpose.
f.1: Correct. New accounts are held at once when setup is required; finishing the five steps opens everything.
f.2: Coaches do see Engagements, once setup is finished.

items.s: Avery pastes their Calendly link as the way to host sessions. What happens?
o: Coach setup warns and won't save it, because coachees would land on a booking page instead of a call.
It saves, and coachees are sent to Calendly to pick a time.

f.0: A booking page never counts as a way to host sessions.
f.2: That's exactly the problem the warning prevents.

items.s: Avery's partner organization blocks calendar connections. What should Avery do?
o: Choose I can't connect a calendar, pick a reason and Skip this step. Admins can see the reason.
Connect a personal calendar instead, without telling anyone.

f.0: While held, Avery can't use the rest of the Studio.
f.2: Connecting the wrong calendar gives coachees wrong availability.

title: Avery's week: where does it go?

items.s: Drag each of Avery's tasks to the place in the Studio where they'd do it.
p: Add "Leading across sites" as a theme for session 2
Share the huddles goal with the sponsor
Change their office hours to weekdays 8 AM – 6 PM
Check that a session-change email reached Casey
items.fr: Correct. Each of Avery's six tasks is in the right place in the Studio.
items.fw:
Not quite. Check where each task lives:

  • Overview tab: The Prep for your next session card is on Overview (and on each upcoming session).
  • Engagement Details: Themes, action items and notes live on each session in Engagement Details.
  • Goals tab: Visibility is set per goal on the Goals tab.
  • Habit Shaper tab: Add a single action on the engagement's Habit Shaper tab.
  • Settings → Calendar: Office hours live under Settings → Calendar (Open Office Hours).
  • Communications tab: Automated emails show there with their delivery status.

items.s: Casey has 6 direct reports but added only 2. What should Avery do?
o: Explain that direct reports need 3 responses to get their own section, and suggest Casey add their other direct reports in their portal.

f.0: With only 2 added, the group can't reach 3 even if both respond.

items.s: Casey asks, "Which of my peers haven't done it yet? I'll nudge them." What does Avery say?

Ask Taylor Brooks to chase the peers.

title: Quinn's Monday
intro: Quinn Harper has four requests on Monday.

items.s: Request 1. Alex Moreau asks Quinn to make the Northwind client portal show "the coaching themes and session notes for the clinic directors". What does Quinn say?
o: Sponsors and client contacts never see notes; Quinn offers the reports portal and the Sponsor Dashboard, which show progress, sessions and shared goals.
Export the notes to a spreadsheet for Alex.

f.2: That breaks the boundary outside the platform.

items.s: Request 2. A new partner coach can't connect their calendar because their other employer blocks it. They're held on setup. What should Quinn suggest?
o: Use I can't connect a calendar, give a reason, and skip the step. Quinn sees the reason in the progress table.
Make the coach an admin so they aren't held.

f.2: Never change someone's role to dodge a check.

items.s: Request 3. A client wants AI switched off for all their coaching. Who does it?
o: The platform team, on the organization's record. Quinn passes the request to support.

f.0: Tenant admins can't change the AI switch.
f.2: Coach opt-outs only cover recording in their own engagements.

items.s: Request 4. A coachee left Northwind. Alex asks Quinn to "get rid of their engagement". What should Quinn do?
o: Set the engagement to Completed (which cancels upcoming sessions), and archive it, unless the contract requires deletion.

f.2: Sessions would stay booked and reminders would go out.
